detail.statement: Computational creativity frameworks require robust integration between formulation and value system learning, now increasingly supported by shared query understanding in multi-agent environments.
detail.reason: New evidence confirms the necessity of shared query understanding in open multi-agent systems for successful creativity integration.

detail.statement: Computational creativity frameworks depend on structured decomposition of problems, which can be significantly enhanced by Agreement Technologies in open systems.
detail.reason: Agreement Technologies provide the formal structure required for collaborative, decomposed problem-solving in open environments.
